source.title: DP590 terminal plastic-work transfer on seven cruciform force ratios
source.paper: Cai et al. A modified yield function for modeling of the evolving yielding behavior and micro-mechanism in biaxial deformation of sheet metals
source.source_kind: Origin 9.3 published 4-column RD/TD true-stress vs logarithmic-plastic-strain plots and companion two-column uniaxial curves, no raw forces or timestamps. First-passage reference rendering and accurate physical power conjugacy are model ingredients.

target: For each mixed worksheet, whole terminal sum of all signed trapezoidal integrals σx dεxᵖ+σy dεyᵖ, in MPa = MJ/m³. Preserve complete component works, stored signs, reversals, first/last rows. This is an endpoint conditional on observed strain records and nominal force labels, not a time-ahead load forecast.
issuance: Metadata and five calibration curves first. After this source lock, decode only the two strain columns A/C on seven held books. No held B/D stresses enter any forecast. Commit all seven forecast banks, including unsupported entries, before scoring stresses.
math: Convex associated local yield loci matched by cumulative work W; positive uniaxial strengths s_d(W) calibrate dε_dd ≤ dW/s_d(W) hence U_d(Δε_dd) ≤ W. Horizontal endpoints use net strains, separate signed per-axis work integrals, local principal frame, plane stress, zero shear for 45deg, same start/end and work origin. First-arrival monotonic branch U_d extracted from raw tensile reference; retain raw signed calibration jitter. Common W need not imply identical physical history. Representability and force conversion not established.
recipe: Two-axis tensile strengths average independent and cruciform calibration at 13 prespecified W knots; 45° external only. Transverse/axial plastic strain slopes from fixed 0.8–1.2W windows at the two pure controls. Point candidate uses geometric mean between convex-hull and supporting-halfspace radial bounds, then inverts u·Δε=integral_0^W dV/rho_u(V) on work grid 0–105 MJ/m³ step .05. Holds exactly for constant true-stress direction, here approximated by the prescribed force direction. Outside grid marks unsupported; no extrapolation. Numerical intervals depend on inferred tangent slopes and the same true-ray approximation. No calibrated probabilistic intervals.
controls: Hill48 reciprocal-gradient average; anisotropic Hosford6; empirical axis-strength blend; source-family Barlat Yld2000 m=4/6/8 with parameters at all 13 work levels regularized toward isotropy; also its m6 midpoint-area variant and net-strain Mises. Alternative midpoint-area candidate reported only as sensitivity. The published variable-exponent full-data fits have mixed-path exposure. These source-family controls exclude that fit and share source access. The five references underdetermine a general 8-parameter fit, so Yld branches are selected regularized procedures.
primary: All seven mixed programs mandatory. Absolute log(predicted/observed terminal signed work), equal per-program mean and maximum. Shared-support geometric midpoint must strictly beat ALL eight designated comparison procedures on BOTH summaries (16 gates); any unsupported whole-program score fails the corresponding gate. No counting rows as independent experimental units.
secondary: For all seven report exact direction-specific minimum work bounds for 0,90,45, and all seven engineering-relaxed results. The largest fractional shortfall across two pure cruciform vs independent same-direction controls at fixed strains .002,.004,.006,.008,.01,.02,.04,.08,.12,.16 is a deterministic calibration sensitivity, not a confidence bound. Report as an inequality test; satisfaction does not establish associated flow. Keep nominal-ray interval coverage distinct from unconditional uniaxial directions. No score selected/reweighted after measurement.
